name: workspace_cleanup
description: Remove an owned run worktree when keepWorktree is false and the workflow outcome is successful. Nested worktrees are removed first; branches are preserved.

keepWorktree.description: If true, the worktree is always retained regardless of owned/outcome.

owned.description: Whether this run owns the worktree. Inherited (unowned) worktrees are never removed.

outcome.description: Workflow outcome; only 'completed', 'success', 'succeeded', 'verified', or 'passed' (case-insensitive) count as successful and allow removal.

sourceRepoPath.description: Path to the source repository the worktree hangs off of. Required only when the worktree is actually removed (keepWorktree=false, owned=true, and outcome is successful).

worktreePath.description: Path to the worktree to remove. Required only when the worktree is actually removed; otherwise echoed back as-is (or empty).

branch.description: Branch name echoed back in the result; never itself deleted.

removed.description: True if the worktree was actually removed.

retained.description: True if the worktree was left in place (the inverse of removed).

reason.description: Why the worktree was retained ('requested', 'inherited', 'outcome=<value>') or removed ('cleanup requested').

worktreePath.description: The worktree path from the input, echoed back (empty string if not supplied).

branch.description: The branch name from the input, echoed back (empty string if not supplied).

removedPaths.description: Present only when removed=true: nested and target worktree paths that were removed.
